item.title: Google, Meta, and Oracle are on a $1 trillion borrowing spree and there will be ‘winners and losers in this environment,’ bond fund manager says
item.description: Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, and Oracle are spending billions to fund the AI buildout—but overinvestment risk means there will be “winners and losers,” said Pimco’s chief investment officer.

item.title: The U.S. is sending an AI-powered anti-drone system to the Mideast as response to countering Iran’s Shahed has been ‘disappointing’
item.description: The drones fired by Iran are a much more basic version of the same drone that Russia is continuously refining and updating in its war in Ukraine.

item.title: Trump calls on regional leaders at ‘Shield of the Americas’ summit to use their militaries against drug cartels
item.description: Notably missing at the summit were the region’s two dominant powers — Brazil and Mexico — as well as Colombia, long the linchpin of U.S. anti-narcotics strategy in the region.

item.title: Subscription burnout has made Gen Z fall in love with all things physical. ‘Amazon’s not going to come into your house and take your DVD’
item.description: Young Americans have enough of the digital world, and going analog to make sense of it all.

item.description: Most ships in the U.S. Navy's fleet are in port or in maintenance and training, with less than a fifth of the force at sea for operations, according to CSIS.
